title: Robust Nonparametric Methods for $α$-Mixing Sequences via Median-of-Means
summary: The median-of-means (MoM) estimator is a robust alternative to the sample mean for heavy-tailed or contaminated data. While its non-asymptotic properties are well understood for i.i.d.\ samples, much less is known for dependent sequences. We establish non-asymptotic deviation bounds for the MoM estimator computed from consecutive blocks of an identically distributed $α$-mixing sequence, both for a single mean and uniformly over a class of functions (the median-of-means process).
